page_title: PAU 0-0 WOL | St. Pauli v Wolfsburg 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+3' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
90+3' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg). Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
90+2' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Kamil Grabara to dive and make a save.
90+1' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick is awarded to St. Pauli.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Tobias Reichel's book.
89' A substitution has been made. Mohamed Amoura goes off and Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) comes on.
87' Here is a change. Carlo Boukhalfa is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Robert Wagner (St. Pauli).
84' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.
82' That will be all from Johannes Eggestein who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Scott Banks (St. Pauli).
82' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) gets a yellow card.
81' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Nikola Vasilj makes a smart save to deny him.
80' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
78' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Jonas Wind and he is replaced by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
76' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Reichel ignores the protests.

74' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
71' The attendance is 29500.
69' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
68' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle as Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolfsburg.
67' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to make a change. Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) replaces Kilian Fischer.
66' That's the end of the game for Danel Sinani, who is replaced by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
66' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

65' That was a nice football moment. Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Kamil Grabara guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Now St. Pauli have a corner.
64' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

63' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Kamil Grabara makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net. St. Pauli will take a corner kick.
62' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kamil Grabara intercepts the ball.
60' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
59' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

59' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) is penalised for holding. Tobias Reichel signals a set piece. Wolfsburg earn a free kick.
53' A goal, which was scored by Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli), was disallowed due to offside.
50' The resulting corner from Eric Smith (St. Pauli) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
50' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
48' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
47' Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

47' A sweet pass finds Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top right corner. Nikola Vasilj is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolfsburg.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The resulting corner from Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+2' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolfsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
45+2' Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg) takes the corner.

45+2' The linesman points to the corner flag, Wolfsburg are going to take it. Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

43' Ooh that was close! Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
43' The resulting corner from Eric Smith (St. Pauli) comes to nothing.

42' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Kamil Grabara has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee blows his whistle, St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.
41' Wolfsburg string together a series of short passes.

38' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
37' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
37' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
36' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
36' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
35' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. St. Pauli get a corner.
32' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
32' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul. Wolfsburg will take a free kick.

31' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
30' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg. A pass by Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
28' A pass by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
28' A cross from Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
26' Poor challenge! Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is penalised for tripping and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle. St. Pauli have a free kick.
25' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
18' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
18' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli will have a chance to score from a corner.

15' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Kamil Grabara pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
13' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle and it's Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Wolfsburg get a free kick.
12' A pass by Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.

10' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
9' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is penalised for a foul. Tobias Reichel had a clear view and blows his whistle. St. Pauli have a free kick.
6' A pass from Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) is intercepted by Kamil Grabara and the move breaks down.
4' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' A lofted cross from Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
2' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to St. Pauli in a dangerous position.
1' The match has just started.
Wolfsburg will kick the game off.
Tobias Reichel will referee today's match.
